personas.name: Light user
personas.description: Occasional use, a few sessions per month

personas.name: Core user
personas.description: Daily use, several sessions per day

complexityBands.name: Light
complexityBands.description: Light use or light work, as Microsoft's planning model defines it for each product

note: Cowork, the Copilot harness, Contact Center Intelligence (Customer Assist), Teams Phone Agent, Copilot Managed Runtime for Apps and the WorkIQ API follow Microsoft's Copilot Credit planning model (https://aka.ms/CopilotCreditPlanningModel): a light, medium or heavy rate or range per unit, 22 working days a month. The generic light/core/power personas are not used for pricing. Copilot Code is not priced yet, as in Microsoft's estimator.

coworkPersonas.name: Corporate knowledge worker
coworkPersonas.description: Many shifting priorities, heavy email and chat, creates docs, decks and spreadsheets

coworkPersonas.name: Manager or senior leader
coworkPersonas.description: Needs headlines, risks and recommendations; decides more than creates; packed calendar

coworkPersonas.name: Customer-facing worker
coworkPersonas.description: Balances customers and internal teams; works by account; relies on relationship history

coworkPersonas.name: Technical worker
coworkPersonas.description: Needs deep focus; produces code, designs or systems; works mostly outside Office apps

coworkIntensities.name: Light
coworkIntensities.description: A couple of times a week, mostly light prompts

coworkIntensities.name: Medium
coworkIntensities.description: A few times a week, light, medium and heavy prompts

coworkIntensities.name: Heavy
